errors.text: The intervention omits the decisive replacement of thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation and does not specify an MTP for dense-fluid sampling.
The cited evidence does not validate machine-learning-potential/DFT free energies, FEP convergence, or melting-property predictions.
The falsification rule uses an undefined 'significant' deviation and lacks a controlled FEP-versus-TI free-energy benchmark.
